title: bug: browser e2e publish drives hand-build approval.branch from the workspace HEAD; take the approval from the daemon's /repository/remote/read preview instead
description:
Parent task-0416061566de49939e91bbd6351be79e, whose step 4 is blocked on this row. That row makes the daemon choose approval.branch: `moe/release/<goalId>` when the remote's recorded default is unknown or equals the workspace branch. No e2e lane has a measured default, because the only measurement runs in node-publisher transmit, after the command. So once the parent passes the target from the preview and the command, a hand-built approval is refused PUBLISH_APPROVAL_STALE @ DAEMON_PREREQUISITE (apps/daemon/src/repository/publish-services.ts:99-101).
Sites, measured at e6369896:
- Default-run in `pnpm test:e2e:browser`, all `branch: "main"` and all expecting ACCEPTED: tests/e2e/control-room/deploy-environment.spec.ts:100, deploy-fake-docker.spec.ts:109, deploy-migrations.spec.ts:142, and lane-rollback-incident.ts:182, which deploy-rollback-incident.spec.ts uses.
- Opt-in or live, each using a checked-out branch name: release-approval.spec.ts:158-167 plus its pushed-branch checks, release-approval-live.spec.ts:282 plus its header comment at :55-62, and live-proof-release.ts:~163-190 plus its comment at :169-171.
Fix, order-independent (green before AND after the parent's wiring, so it lands first): each drive takes `approval` from the daemon's own preview, POST /repository/remote/read {goalId, remoteUrl} -> body.approval, exactly as the control-room Publish card does, instead of hand-building the branch. Every pushed-branch assertion reads that approval.branch.
definitionOfDone: Every site named in the description obtains its publish approval from the daemon's /repository/remote/read preview. `git grep -n 'branch: "main"' -- tests/e2e/control-room` returns no publish-approval literal. The whole-tree census is recorded in the completion record.

The four default-run specs (deploy-environment, deploy-fake-docker, deploy-migrations, deploy-rollback-incident) pass under `pnpm test:e2e:browser` at the delivered tree, and the `N passed` count line is quoted. Those runs take the browser-e2e-gate lease.

`tsc -p tests/e2e/control-room/tsconfig.json` exits 0. The opt-in/live drives' pushed-branch assertions read the approval's branch, never their checked-out name, and their comments that pin `publication-candidate.ts:21` as the branch source are corrected.
